The year starts whether you
plan for it or not.

This is for you if

  • Your business already works. The next level isn't more hours, it's better decisions, made faster, with someone who's already made them before.
  • You want the whole year handled: WMHQ for the everyday work, and a direct line to me the moment a launch, a price change, or a hard call needs a second brain.
  • You've made big calls alone before and you're done doing that. You want someone in your corner who's already made the exact call you're stuck on.
  • You'd rather plan the year once than re-decide it every quarter.
  • You book the call when you say you will. If it's on your calendar, you show up.

This isn't for you if

  • You won't book the calls. Private support only works if you use it. If they'd sit on your calendar untouched, keep your $5,000.
  • You haven't decided if WMHQ is right for you yet. Start there. Add this once you already know.
  • You want someone to do the work between calls for you. This gives you the decision, not homework finished for you.
  • You don't have 3 to 6 hours a week to work on your business, your mindset and your income.

Hi, I'm Jess.

Business Strategist and Mindset Coach, Founder of Woman Mastery HQ

I work with female founders who have hit a ceiling that more hours won't fix. My work combines business strategy with subconscious identity work, because the numbers rarely move until the woman running the business does.

Inside WMHQ, that means building a profitable, sustainable business through every season of life, and getting properly visible while you do it.

Questions you have, answered.

Have a question? DM me

What happens as soon as I join?

You get your WMHQ login and your Private Blackout Dashboard straight away, and a 45-minute onboarding call with me is included when you join WMHQ. From there you book your Advisory calls whenever you need them.

When can I use my private calls?

Any time across your 12 months. You book your 2 Advisory calls through your Private Blackout Dashboard whenever you need them.

When does the JP Hotline month run?

You choose when to activate it, so you can save it for a launch or a big decision month.

Will this package open again?

No. This is the 2026 Black Friday package, open from 20 November to 1 December with 5 spots, and that is all.

What happens if I don't use all my calls or Hotline days?

They're yours for the year, but they don't roll over past that. This works best if you book them in, not save them for "someday." Treat it like time already paid for, because it is.

What are the private Advisory calls for?

Whatever decision is in front of you: pricing, a launch, an offer that is stuck, or the sales problem you keep circling. We make the call, map the next moves, and get it out of your head.

What is The Next 60 Checklist and Dashboard?

It is your 60-day plan in one place: 4 phases, 16 actions and a dashboard that tracks what you have done and what is next, so you always know what to work on.

What is the Seen in Seasons Workshop?

A live training on running your business in three seasons, so you stop planning every year like it is one long sprint. It is yours to keep and rewatch.

How does the 2027 Visionary Planning Session work?

It is a 2-hour group session, not a 1:1 call. We map your 2027 revenue goals, offers, launches and priorities together, and you leave knowing what you are building and what gets your attention first. The date is being scheduled, so stay tuned.

What happens after the 12 months are up?

Your WMHQ membership continues at $450 a month unless you give 30 days’ notice in writing before your 12 months are up. We will email you a reminder before that date, so nothing is a surprise.

How does the payment plan work?

Choose $5,000 once, or 12 payments of $420. Same access either way, from day one, not staged as you pay. Read the full Terms & Conditions here.

What if the 5 spots fill up?

Then the page closes early. This is a 2026 Black Friday package only, so it will not open again.

What is the refund and cancellation policy?

There are no refunds. Full cancellation terms are set out in the Terms & Conditions. Please read them before you purchase.
